name: Sports Medicine Academy (Research Scholars)
org: UC San Diego Division of Extended Studies
what_you_do: Learn about sports injuries, anatomy and care. Practice skills like taping and wound care, and do a small research project with wearable tech. Winter 2027 is online, with Saturday Zoom classes plus self-paced work.
grades: 11 to 12 (the course description says incoming 11th and 12th graders)
who_can_apply: 11th and 12th graders with a cumulative GPA of 3.3 or better who are interested in sports medicine. No application is needed; you enroll directly.
pay_detail: $2,000 for Winter 2027 (live online). The in-person summer course is listed at $3,500 (commuter only; no housing or transportation). Some lab supplies cost extra. No financial aid; you can ask for a payment plan.
duration: Winter 2027: Jan 11 to Mar 20, 2027, Saturdays 9:30 to 11:00 a.m. on Zoom plus self-paced work. Summer in person: weekdays 9:30 a.m. to 2:30 p.m. (2026 ran July 6 to July 24); 2027 dates not posted.
deadline_text: Winter 2027 enrollment is open and closes Jan 4, 2027. Summer 2027 is listed as coming soon, and the summer course says enrollment is coming December 2026.
how_to_apply: Enroll directly on the Extended Studies registration page. Add the course to your cart. No application or essay is needed. Questions: precollege@ucsd.edu.
notes: Earns 3 to 6 UC pre-college units. UCSD's Research Scholars also offers life sciences and marine science courses; its older Academic Connections summer program was canceled for 2026. Marine science fall 2026 application closed Sept 17, 2026.
